task.question: At the selected revision, what is the signature and documented purpose of Session.request? Locate its definition, read its source/docstring and cite exact physical source lines. Keep runtime behaviour unverified.

list_files.description: Discover raw tree files and inclusion/exclusion metadata at an explicit revision.

read_file.description: Read up to200 physical LF source lines at an explicit revision; returns exact citation and follow-up next_line.

search.description: Literal search over included raw source at an explicit revision; paged matches have exact line citations and coverage gaps. Follow next_cursor when needed.

show_commit.description: Inspect immutable commit object, ordered parents and decoded text.
